body: Heads up before your U8 full-suite run: master currently has 8 failing tests and none are from U8. Seven (belt_scale, booking_board_api, featured_real_athletes, fight_camp, fight_contract, retention, rivalries) were green at 37cde40 and red at 4e353eb 'Add GRAPPLE as seventh athlete stat' - Codex's C43 regression, bounced back to it as C43F. The eighth, 'overview builds the hero' in profile_revamp_test, is pre-existing and predates C43. Do not spend a pass fixing them and do not let them block your commit; report your own suite number and note these 8 as known. Note C43 edited ProfileRevampPanel.gd, Aging.gd, AthleteDevelopment.gd and WorldPopulation.gd - the same files U8 is in - so rebase on origin/master before you finish. Q4 RecoveryWords landed; TASK_U9 now points at it and InjuryWords instead of inventing phrasing.
